idx_intro: A browser extension that exports Microsoft Teams chat messages to CSV or HTML, including files, images and emoji reactions. Attachments are bundled into a single ZIP, and the full conversation history is scrolled automatically so nothing is missed.
idx_card: Everything happens in your browser. Your messages and files are processed locally on your device and are never sent to us or to any third party server. See the privacy policy for details.
idx_f1: Captures the entire chat history with automatic scrolling
idx_f2: CSV and self-contained HTML transcript exports
idx_f3: File attachments and pasted screenshots, bundled into one streaming ZIP
idx_f4: Emoji reactions and quoted message context preserved
idx_f5: Available in 20 languages, switchable at runtime
idx_f6: Works on teams.microsoft.com, teams.live.com, and teams.cloud.microsoft
idx_support: Questions, bug reports, or feature requests:
pp_meta: Effective date: 12 July 2026. Applies to the "Teams Message Extractor" browser extension.
pp_summary: Summary: everything the extension does happens locally in your browser. Your Teams messages, files and exports never leave your device. We collect no analytics and run no servers, so we never see any of your data.
pp_s1_h: What the extension does with your data
pp_s1_p: When you start an extraction, the extension reads the Microsoft Teams conversation that is open in your browser tab and builds the export (CSV, HTML, or ZIP of attachments) entirely on your device. The resulting files are saved through your browser's normal download mechanism to your computer. Message content is never transmitted to the extension's developer or to any third party.
pp_s2_l1: Settings (language preference, scroll delay, export options) are stored in your browser's local extension storage.
pp_s2_l2: Extraction results are kept temporarily in session storage so the popup can restore its state if you close and reopen it. They are automatically cleared after 30 minutes, or when the tab closes.
pp_s2_l3: A first install timestamp is stored locally so that, if a paid tier launches in the future, long time users can be recognised for an early supporter discount. It never leaves your device.
pp_s3_l1: No analytics or telemetry of any kind
pp_s3_l2: No account, sign up, or personal information
pp_s3_l3: No message content, file content, contact names, or metadata sent anywhere
pp_s3_l4: No cookies, no fingerprinting, no advertising identifiers
pp_s4_h: Why the extension requests its permissions
pp_s4_l1: Teams domains (teams.microsoft.com, teams.live.com, teams.cloud.microsoft): to read the open conversation so it can be exported.
pp_s4_l2: SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams media hosts (sharepoint.com, 1drv.ms, asm.skype.com and related): to download the file attachments and images that appear in your chats, using your existing signed in session. These downloads go directly from Microsoft's servers to your device.
pp_s4_l3: Storage: for the settings and temporary state listed above.
pp_s4_l4: Downloads: to save your exports to your computer.
pp_s5_p: A paid tier is planned for a future update (see the Paid Model FAQ). If and when it launches, activating a licence will send only your licence key and a random, anonymous installation identifier to our payment and licensing provider, Lemon Squeezy, to validate the licence. Payment details are handled entirely by Lemon Squeezy under their privacy policy. The extension never sees your payment information, and your Teams message content will continue to be processed only on your device. This policy will be updated before any such change takes effect.
pp_s6_p: Material changes will be announced in the extension's release notes and reflected on this page with a new effective date.
fq_meta: Last updated: 12 July 2026. Details below will be filled in as they are confirmed.
fq_card: The short version: the extension will move to a paid model in a future update. Not yet, and not without warning. You'll get advance notice here and in the extension, a free grace period of one month, and existing users will get a discounted early supporter price.
fq_q1_p: No date is set yet. When one is, it will be announced in the extension itself and on this page well in advance, followed by a full month where everything keeps working free of charge.
fq_q2_h: Will I lose anything I have today?
fq_q2_p: No. If you installed before the change, everything you use today keeps working, including unlimited message exports and channel exports. The paid model changes what new installs get, not what you already have.
fq_q3_h: What will paid features look like?
fq_q3_p: New installs after the change will get a free tier that exports up to 50 messages per chat in every format, and a Pro tier for power use: a one-time payment (planned: 15 US dollars, with a discounted early supporter price of 7 US dollars for existing users) unlocks unlimited messages, channel (Posts) exports, and future Pro features such as PDF and DOCX export. Local features will never need a subscription.
fq_q4_h: How will existing users be recognised?
fq_q4_p: The extension locally records when it was first installed. Installs that predate the announcement will be offered the discounted early supporter price automatically. Nothing about this leaves your device. See the privacy policy.

pp_s8_h: Cookies and analytics on this website
pp_s8_p: The policy above covers the browser extension, which collects no analytics data at all. This website (adamtomsltd.github.io) uses Google Analytics to count visits and see which pages are useful. Analytics cookies are set only if you accept them in the cookie banner, and you can change your choice at any time via the “Cookie settings” link at the bottom of every page. If you decline, no analytics cookies are set.
